name: 32563 · Gulf Breeze, FL
findings: ZIP 32563 (Gulf Breeze) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32563 (Gulf Breeze) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32563 (Gulf Breeze) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
